description: This file implements a reference index store for quoted messages, including loading, saving, compacting, and retrieving message references with attachments, used in a QQ bot extension.

classes.name: RefIndexEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a stored quoted message, including content, sender info, timestamp, and attachments.

classes.name: RefAttachmentSummary
classes.description: Interface representing a summary of an attachment associated with a quoted message.

classes.name: RefIndexLine
classes.description: Internal interface representing a line in the JSONL store with key, value, and timestamp.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Lazily loads the JSONL store into memory, parsing existing file lines into a cache.

methods.name: appendLine
methods.description: Appends a new record to the JSONL file.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures the storage directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: shouldCompact
methods.description: Determines if the store should be compacted based on size and threshold.

methods.name: compactFile
methods.description: Creates a compacted version of the store, rewriting the JSONL file with current cache.

methods.name: evictIfNeeded
methods.description: Evicts old entries from cache based on TTL and maximum size constraints.

methods.name: setRefIndex
methods.description: Stores a reference index entry for a message, updating cache and file.

methods.name: getRefIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a reference index entry by its key, returning null if expired or not found.

methods.name: formatRefEntryForAgent
methods.description: Formats a reference index entry into a string suitable for model context, including attachments.

methods.name: flushRefIndex
methods.description: Flushes the store, compacting the file if needed before process exit.

methods.name: getRefIndexStats
methods.description: Returns diagnostic stats about the reference index store.
